note: Both sets contain identical OCR errors, misreading the finished floor elevation '2' - 9 1/2"' as '2' 3 1/2"' in two claims each. Set B is preferred because it provides higher granularity by correctly binding elevations to specific rooms (Bedroom, Kitchen) in addition to sections, resulting in more useful and correct claims overall without increasing the error count. Set A is more repetitive with generic section claims and lacks the specific room-to-elevation relationships captured by Set B.
